Rina: Heads-up: small docs PR #4710 that consolidates the Console quickstart, adds a compact dashboard preset for cost/latency, and includes a 'trace hook' rename checklist (traceKey -> trace_id). Need someone to run linkcheck and confirm SDK snippets. @DevEx Sam?
DevEx Sam: I can do linkcheck + snippets. Preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4710/preview?env=docs
Rina: Thanks. Also added a tiny before/after box for kv-prefetch impact (numbers are illustrative). Please flag if we need stronger wording.
Marco (eng): FYI runtime v2.1 contains a shim that accepts traceKey, but recommend telling users to update dashboards and alerting rules to use trace_id to avoid future surprises.
Infra Zoe: Microbench requested. I'll run a quick job and drop numbers in the PR thread.
Ivy (product): Suggested blurb: "Example: median 130ms -> 100ms; p99 300ms -> 260ms; est cost/unit $0.0049 -> $0.0041 (workload dependent)." Keep it clearly labeled as approximations.
DevEx Sam: Running smoke/linkcheck: `./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4710 --suite quick --linkcheck`
site-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4710 -> staging
DevEx Sam: Smoke OK. Linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (old tracehook deep-dive). Left PR note.
Rina: I'll patch link and add a short migration snippet for Node/Python/Go mapping ctx keys.
Marco (eng): Snippet examples look fine. For Go show context.Value mapping, for Node show span.setTag rename.
Infra Zoe: Microbench summary (short): median down ~23%, p99 down ~13%, token cost per request down ~11%. Pushed numbers to PR.
DevEx Sam: Pushed snippet formatting fix (commit a1b2c3). Re-ran linkcheck -> all green.
Rina: Added reviewers and a one-line migration checklist at top: 1) Upgrade SDKs to v3.4+ for automatic mapping; 2) If pinned to older SDKs, rename traceKey -> trace_id in code and dashboards; 3) Verify alerts/queries.
Ivy (product): LGTM. Good to call out the alerts bit.
DevEx Sam: Approved, merging after CI finishes.
site-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4710 -> staging (status: success)
Rina: Merged and backported to the 3.x docs set. Closing thread — thanks for fast review! :tada:
